sources.summary: Exclusive: Work, whose subject resembles street urchin in masterpiece by artist, chanced upon in private collection A red chalk drawing of a crouching child, spotted in a private Italian collection, has been attributed by an art historian to the French modernist painter Édouard Manet. The child, whose identity has yet to be established, resembles a street urchin in the Manet masterpiece The Old Musician , in which he sought to show the humanity of homeless and marginalised people.
